           STIPULATION IN LIEU OF CROSS-EXAMINATION BETWEEN
          MEYER E11 INTERVENORS AND BRADY CREEK INTERVENORS

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

       COMES NOW Paul & Jane Meyer Family Foundation, SM Retreat Ltd. and Leslie Meyer

Rhea [“Meyer E11 Intervenors”] and the Solana Intervenors and Brady Creek/Wolf Bluff

Intervenors [“Brady Creek Intervenors”], and offer the following stipulation in lieu of the cross-

examination of witness Frederick B. Wulff, Jr.:

       Stipulations

       The Brady Creek Intervenors stipulate to the following facts in addition to the Cross-

Rebuttal Testimony of Frederick B. Wulff, Jr.:

   1. Frederick B. Wulff, Jr. has not personally visited the SM Retreat property on Link E11 or

       otherwise observed the property directly.




                                                                                            Page 1
 2. Frederick B. Wulff, Jr. has no knowledge regarding the actual usage of the 1,800-foot

   landing strip on the SM Retreat property described in the Direct Testimony of Deborah

   Hansen.

3. The Brady Creek Intervenors are not aware of any PUC Rule or provision in PURA that

   requires a quantified level of usage before a private landing strip should be considered in

   routing determinations.

4. The Brady Creek Intervenors are not aware of any PUC Rule or provision in PURA that

   requires FAA registration before a private landing strip should be considered in routing

   determinations.

5. The factual basis for the Cross-Rebuttal Testimony of Frederick B. Wulff, Jr. related to the

   1,800-foot landing strip on the SM Retreat property (described in the Direct Testimony of

   Deborah Hansen) was his review of a series of Google Earth and Google Maps satellite

   and aerial photographs which depict the SM Retreat property between 2005 and 2026. .

6. The Brady Intervenors have no knowledge whether the Google Earth images reviewed by

   Frederick B. Wulff, Jr. are accurate representations of the continuous condition of the SM

   Retreat property during the periods of time between when the images were taken.

7. Frederick B. Wulff, Jr. cannot testify based on personal knowledge that there is not an

   1,800-foot grass landing strip on the SM Retreat property.


   Respectfully submitted,
